lina (eng-ml): quick check — trying to finish the helios6b catalog entry. I hit two things: the GCS path I was given errors with missing config.json, and locally the tokenizer seems to strip leading whitespace from prompts which breaks some RL evaluation prompts. Can someone grab weights location + run a short latency smoke for batch sizes 1/4/8? cc @sanjay

sanjay (runtime): i looked into this this morning. weights are in s3://inference-artifacts/helios6b/6.7b-final.tar.gz — the GCS path was an old mirror that wasn't updated. i'll push a manifest to model-catalog. tokenizer is sentencepiece-based; default loader was using no BOS. quick workaround: set `add_bos=true` in tokenizer config. i'll kick off a local smoke on an A100 VM now.

maria (bench): starting a quick perf run on a 1-GPU smoke (dev pool) with seq=1024. i'll post numbers here, small sample.

bench-bot: perf-smoke started /runs/1782501111-smoke (node=a100-dev-03)

maria (bench): results (sample):
- batch=1: p50=18ms p95=120ms p99=320ms
- batch=4: p50=22ms p95=150ms p99=420ms
- batch=8: p50=32ms p95=240ms p99=760ms
memory resident ~38GB, peak with kv-cache ~44GB. looks like tail latency jumps with larger batches and long seq.

sanjay (runtime): thanks — that p99 tail is worrying. i saw a KV cache growth pattern on this model; likely because attention memory layout for `rotary` + seq=1024 pushes kernel GEMM tiling to less efficient paths. also fyi catalog config used `attention_type: flash` by default; our older kernels fall back to matmul which increases latency. we should add a `compatibility` flag in the catalog entry.

chris (serving): config-validator also flagged `attention_type: flash` + `quantization: int8` as unsupported on a few images. suggestion: include `kernel_profile: {"flash_ok": false, "min_cuda": "12.1"}` in manifest and set default runtime to `matmul` for older nodes. i'll draft a sample manifest diff.

lina (eng-ml): here's a tokenizer snippet we should add to the model entry so downstream loaders are consistent:
```json
{
  "tokenizer": "sentencepiece",
  "add_bos": true,
  "normalizer": "nfc",
  "max_length": 2048,
  "pad_to_multiple_of": 8
}
```
please include that in the PR.

maria (bench): also saw some GPU memory fragmentation on repeated runs (small frees between requests). for the smoke i disabled continuous-batching; when i re-enabled it, tail p99 improved for batch 8 (~600ms) but throughput increased. tradeoff to consider.

tom (docs): i'll open the PR to model-catalog with: weights S3 manifest, tokenizer config (add_bos), kernel_profile, and suggest default batch sizing = 4, max_seq = 1024. will tag @sanjay @chris for runtime / infra review.

lina (eng-ml): plan sounds good. actionable list:
- chris: add kernel_profile and fallback defaults in manifest (thanks)
- sanjay: validate no-BOS edgecases for our evals and run a full perf tomorrow on dedicated infra (p99, p50, throughput)
- maria: run long-run stability (30m) with continuous-batching enabled and share logs
- tom: PR + small release note about tokenizer quirk

can people ack? :thumbsup:

chris (serving): ack :thumbsup:

sanjay (runtime): ack, i'll schedule the run for tomorrow morning UTC

maria (bench): ack, will post logs here when done

bench-bot: perf logs uploaded -> https://internal-storage/redwood/runs/1782501111/logs (access: eng-ml)
